name: Charmareians
source:
The Charmareian race is in a dire situation. Our offspring are infected by what our people call a plague. They label these Charmareians as Outliers. Said Outliers have been treated poorly for long enough! I will not stand by any longer while my people are fighting amongst themselves!

Every passing day, the Misfit army grows bigger and stronger! We will do whatever it takes to bring the people of Charmara together.

Not everyone can become a Misfit, but all ask for is your support! If you're interested in joining, please talk to one of my elite members!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1961740/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
Charmareian种族正处于悲惨的境地。我们的后代被我们的人民所说的瘟疫感染了。他们将这些魅力主义者标记为离群者。所说的离群者长期以来一直受到恶劣对待！当我的人民互相争斗时，我不会再袖手旁观！

日复一日，Misfit大军越来越壮大！我们将尽一切努力让查马拉人民团结起来。

不是每个人都能成为Misfit，但需要的是你的支持！如果你有兴趣加入，请与我的一位精英会员交谈！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1961740/]Steam[/url]]
